Messages.Author: Chaitan
Messages.Body:
On 15 Sep, 14:46, bodhi <jordi.sam...@gmail.com> wrote:
> kyoko hunts two (hospital food, for examplE) from a vamp who has one
> blood. Kk gains one or two?

Also depends on that card used to modify the hunt action. 1 blood
gained if hospital and/or aaron's feeding razor was used but two blood
with the anarch free press (because that extra blood comes from the
blood bank).

Kyoko:
Kyoko cannot hunt as normal. She may hunt by stealing a blood from
another ready vampire as a +1 stealth (D) action.

Hospital food:
Tap when an anarch announces a hunting action. If that action is
successful, the anarch gains an additional blood.

Aaron's Feeding Razor:
When this vampire successfully hunts, he or she gains 1 additional
blood.

The Anarch Free Press:
You may tap this card when an anarch successfully hunts to give that
anarch an extra blood from the blood bank.
